instruction: Plan the approved refactor as file-sized brownfield TaskPackets. Inspect the supplied complete source. If Column already delegates all header responsibilities to ColumnHeader, return an empty packets array and a precise no-op rationale. Otherwise emit only refactor_extract or patch_apply packets with intent refactor and artifact_path limited to the confirmed allowlist. Do not invent changes or rename Column terminology.

inputs.content: Approved requirements: Column must own only container/dropzone state and composition; ColumnHeader must own all header rendering, permissions, dialogs, archive mutation/store/toast. If already true, no source change is required.

Inspect both files together. Execute a no-op if extraction is complete; otherwise apply the smallest extraction and preserve all listed UI, permission, state, side-effect, accessibility, and drag/drop invariants.

ColumnHeader imports produce, Archive, Plus, React state, i18n, CreateTaskModal, useUpdateTask, useWorkspacePermission, getColumnIcon, toast, project store, ProjectWithTasks, and ArchiveTasksModal. It receives column; owns project/store/update hooks and create/update permission checks; owns archive/task modal state; handleConfirmArchive updates each final-column task to archived, clears tasks in produced project, updates store, emits translated toast, and closes modal. Its JSX renders icon, name, task count, permission-gated archive/add buttons with translated titles, CreateTaskModal, and ArchiveTasksModal.
inputs.reason: Complete responsibility inventory from current ColumnHeader source

acceptance: Empty packets when extraction is complete
Any packet is restricted to allowlisted paths
No terminology rename or behavior change is planned
